<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brand" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="photo" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
    <clipPath id="photoClip">
      <circle cx="195" cy="156" r="72"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">9:41</text>
  <line x1="320" y1="17" x2="326" y2="17" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="320" y1="14" x2="326" y2="14" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="320" y1="11" x2="326" y2="11" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="340" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="18" x2="343" y2="12" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="354" y="9" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="375" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
  <rect x="357" y="12" width="14" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#4A4A4A"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="28,57 37,48 46,57 43,57 43,68 31,68 31,57" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="url(#brand)">tinder</text>
    <circle cx="355" cy="57" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="53" r="3" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <ellipse cx="355" cy="62" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="18" y1="86" x2="372" y2="86" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- profile hero shadow/card -->
  <rect x="18" y="98" width="354" height="229" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity=".06"/>
  <rect x="18" y="96" width="354" height="229" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="156" r="76" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="156" r="72" fill="url(#photo)"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#photoClip)">
    <circle cx="195" cy="138" r="27" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="190" rx="50" ry="38" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="184" cy="136" r="3" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <circle cx="206" cy="136" r="3" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <line x1="187" y1="154" x2="203" y2="154" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="195,151 190,145 200,145" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="251" cy="209" r="18" fill="url(#brand)" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4"/>
  <polyline points="244,209 249,214 259,203" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <text x="195" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">John, 26</text>
  <text x="195" y="282" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#939393">Profile verified · New York</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="143" y="294" width="104" height="28" rx="14" fill="#FFF0F4"/>
    <circle cx="160" cy="308" r="5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="170" y="313" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#C42936">EDIT PROFILE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- completion -->
  <text x="24" y="356" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Profile completion</text>
  <text x="366" y="356" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FE3675">78%</text>
  <rect x="24" y="367" width="342" height="9" rx="5" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
  <rect x="24" y="367" width="267" height="9" rx="5" fill="url(#brand)"/>
  <text x="24" y="397" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#939393">Add a photo and answer 2 prompts to get more matches.</text>

  <!-- premium section -->
  <text x="24" y="430" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Get more from Tinder</text>
  <text x="366" y="430" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#FE3675">MANAGE</text>

  <!-- premium cards -->
  <rect x="22" y="444" width="110" height="125" rx="15" fill="#000000" opacity=".05"/>
  <rect x="20" y="442" width="110" height="125" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="470" r="20" fill="#FFF4D5"/>
  <polygon points="75,457 79,467 90,468 82,475 84,486 75,480 66,486 68,475 60,468 71,467" fill="#EFC54D"/>
  <text x="75" y="514" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Super Likes</text>
  <text x="75" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">3 remaining</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="42" y="545" width="66" height="20" rx="10" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <text x="75" y="559" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">VIEW</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="140" y="444" width="110" height="125" rx="15" fill="#000000" opacity=".05"/>
  <rect x="138" y="442" width="110" height="125" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="193" cy="470" r="20" fill="#E9F8DE"/>
  <polygon points="193,453 197,465 209,465 199,473 203,485 193,478 183,485 187,473 177,465 189,465" fill="#96E063"/>
  <text x="193" y="514" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Boosts</text>
  <text x="193" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">1 available</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="160" y="545" width="66" height="20" rx="10" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <text x="193" y="559" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">VIEW</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="258" y="444" width="110" height="125" rx="15" fill="#000000" opacity=".05"/>
  <rect x="256" y="442" width="110" height="125" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="311" cy="470" r="20" fill="#FFF0F4"/>
  <polygon points="311,454 315,464 326,464 317,471 320,483 311,477 302,483 305,471 296,464 307,464" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <text x="311" y="514" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Upgrade</text>
  <text x="311" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" fill="#939393">See all benefits</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="278" y="545" width="66" height="20" rx="10" fill="#FFF0F4"/>
    <text x="311" y="559" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#C42936">EXPLORE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- account options -->
  <rect x="20" y="586" width="350" height="106" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <circle cx="43" cy="610" r="12" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="607" r="3.5" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <ellipse cx="43" cy="615" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <text x="67" y="615" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4A4A4A">Account settings</text>
    <polyline points="345,606 351,612 345,618" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="67" y1="630" x2="350" y2="630" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <circle cx="43" cy="657" r="12" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="43" cy="657" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="653" x2="43" y2="657" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="657" x2="47" y2="660" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="67" y="662" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4A4A4A">Privacy and safety</text>
    <polyline points="345,653 351,659 345,665" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- continue button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="84" y="710" width="222" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#brand)" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <text x="195" y="738" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="780" width="390" height="64" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="780" x2="390" y2="780" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="45,802 54,794 63,802 60,802 60,813 48,813 48,802" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="54" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">DISCOVER</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="132" cy="802" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="126,802 130,806 138,797" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="132" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">LIKES</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="194" y="794" width="20" height="15" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="199,809 199,814 204,809" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="204" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">CHAT</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="292" cy="802" r="10" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <circle cx="292" cy="799" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="292" cy="806" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="292" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#FE3675">PROFILE</text>
  </g>
</svg>
